sources.title: Labelling F gas equipment you produce, import or install
Fluorinated gas (F gas): guidance for users, producers and traders

facts.source_fact: Products produced, imported or installed that contain regulated F gas must be labelled.
The label must include the industry name of the F gas.
The label must include the mass of F gas in kilograms.
The label must include the F-gas amount in equivalent tonnes of carbon dioxide.
The label must include the global warming potential of the F gas.
Hermetically sealed equipment must be labelled as containing hermetically sealed F gas when the official criteria are met.
Permanent sealing may include welded or brazed closure.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve examples without making them exhaustive.

facts.source_fact: Capped valves or service ports are compatible with hermetic classification when the other criteria are met.
The tested leak-rate criterion for hermetic classification is less than 3 grams per year.
Label data describe equipment/gas compliance and are not a direct parcel-level emissions measurement.
